message:
Fixed. `Crème brûlée recipes` now slugs to `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now decomposes accented characters (NFD) and strips the combining marks before calling `slugify`, so "è" becomes "e" rather than being dropped. I left `vendor/slugify` alone because it is vendored and its README says not to edit it by hand.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the same vendored `slugify`, so product URLs still drop accents. You didn't ask about products, so I didn't change them. If you want the same behavior there, the change is a one-liner in that file. I haven't committed anything.
